target.what: Arm_motion_bench's pendulum workspace v2 dev-007 tape at 0.5 (a 138 deg swing, bam_ruckig), every time x1 (nominal). Tests tracking on a fixed target at this speed.

configs.title: the trajectory's column (as built), board PD
configs.why: the as-built baseline (the tape's own column, board PD, no lookahead: what the arm runs today); twin at pendulum/path@nominal·50Hz·bus=datasheet·ff±10%·gains×1: tool p95 7.11 mm, joint p95 1.2 deg
configs.feedback: the boards' PD at the station's own gains (fullarm_jtc's on bam_fb)

configs.title: model at plan time, board PD, the datasheet's lookahead, secant_mid_ff
configs.why: real-safe #1 for accuracy of 12 passing at pendulum/path@nominal·50Hz·bus=datasheet·ff±10%·gains×1: tool p95 5.48 mm, joint p95 0.927 deg
configs.feedback: the boards' PD at the station's own gains (fullarm_jtc's on bam_fb)
configs.interpolation_in_bundle: qd <- (q(t + T) - q(t)) / T and effort <- effort(t + T/2), T = the JTC's tick period

configs.title: the trajectory's column (as built), board PD, secant_mid_ff
configs.why: real-safe #2 for accuracy of 12 passing at pendulum/path@nominal·50Hz·bus=datasheet·ff±10%·gains×1: tool p95 6.24 mm, joint p95 1.05 deg
configs.feedback: the boards' PD at the station's own gains (fullarm_jtc's on bam_fb)
configs.interpolation_in_bundle: qd <- (q(t + T) - q(t)) / T and effort <- effort(t + T/2), T = the JTC's tick period

configs.title: model at plan time, board PD, the datasheet's lookahead
configs.why: real-safe #3 for accuracy of 12 passing at pendulum/path@nominal·50Hz·bus=datasheet·ff±10%·gains×1: tool p95 6.38 mm, joint p95 1.08 deg
configs.feedback: the boards' PD at the station's own gains (fullarm_jtc's on bam_fb)

calibration.why: xcorr on pendulum/calibration·50Hz·bus=stagger·ff±0%·gains×1 (one run at zero lookahead, each joint's best-aligning shift): measured 26.00 ms vs nominal 1.25 ms (datasheet:mjbots (fdcanusb ~800 Hz, one device)): off by +24.75 ms, beyond the 2 ms tolerance
calibration.bus_why: xcorr on pendulum/calibration·50Hz·bus=stagger·ff±0%·gains×1 (one run at zero lookahead, each joint's best-aligning shift with the friction look-alike fitted out): measured 20.75 ms vs nominal 1.25 ms (datasheet:mjbots (fdcanusb ~800 Hz, one device)): off by +19.50 ms, beyond the 2 ms tolerance

score_against: the bundle's q_reference on the JTC's leg clock (robot_controllers.real.import_fullarm)
logger_ask: stamp each exchange's start and the order the boards are served in (or each reply's own time): with the exchange's end alone, one run bounds the delay only to one exchange (~17 ms), so the calibration is the sweep
why: robot_controllers never drives hardware (CONTRACT §5.9): the rig's owner builds and queues these
